text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile Championship is
finally here.
Daiichi Ruby won't be the
only runner to watch
out for—Daitaku
Helios is racing too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt today's race is going to
be
tough. And perhaps Yamanin Zephyr
knows it
too—I can tell she's nervous.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It's time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well, off I go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression seems sunny somehow, as
if full of
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here they come! It's the Mile
Championship
runners!

text_block_list.name: Helios Fan
text_block_list.text:
Heliooos! Show us some more fierce
front running
todayyy!

text_block_list.name: Ruby Fan
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Rubyyy! I eagerly anticipate a
sterling
performance from youuu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...It's a swirling vortex, whipped up by
the
spectators.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wa-HEYYY!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pump it up to the max! Full-on front running frenzy! Time to tear it uuup, YEEEAH! ★★★

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Helios's storm-force wind...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: A pleasure to see you here.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I promise you my glorious victory.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Ruby's heavenly wind...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps they were all winds—one by
one,
sweeping across the land I see
before me.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(At times they rage and swirl,
obstructing my wind
stream.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(But I realized something at the Sprinters
Stakes.
So long as I remain a strong wind
myself...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(So long as I maintain the unshakable
resolve to
become the supreme wind
that surpasses all
else...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I can draw in the swirling vortex, the
storm-force
wind, the heavenly wind! I
can draw them all in
and become an
even more ferocious wind!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I shall go out there with my spirit ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know I have the resolve in my heart.
Which
means... I will not end as a mere
mellow breeze.
